searched.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: ABS-GF
searched.note: All 5 pages read (text layer, page by page): Basic Info, Specifications and Recommended Printing Settings (p.1), Physical and Mechanical Properties (p.2), Other Physical and Chemical Properties and Specimen Test (p.3), test charts and Disclaimer (pp.4-5). Glass Transition Temperature and Crystallization Temperature read "N/A". No filament length, hardness or diameter tolerance is given. No certification is named. The Nozzle Size row is written to extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters; the Chamber Temperature row (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp, a printer key (see notes).

searched.title: Bambu ABS GF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701B50
searched.note: All 19 pages read. Section 1 (p.2): product name "Bambu ABS GF", model "B50-xx". Section 2 (p.3): not classified under (EC) No 1272/2008. Section 3 (p.4): ABS 80-90 % by wt, glass fibre 10-20 % by wt. Section 8 (pp.8-9): fibre-debris handling warning, gloves advised. Section 9 (pp.9-10): "No data available" for melting point, density and every other physical datum. Section 14 (pp.13-14): not hazardous goods (IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID, ICAO/IATA). Section 15 (p.16): SVHC not listed. No certification is named.

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: ABS-GF
Bambu ABS GF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701B50
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: ABS-GF
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
ABS GF / PA6 GF Glass Fiber Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens printed at nozzle 270 °C, bed 80 °C, 150 mm/s, 100% infill, annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 29 ± 3 MPa, elongation 2.3% ± 0.8%, bending modulus 1970 ± 110 MPa, bending strength 46 ± 3 MPa, impact 5.3 ± 1.4 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 3160 ± 170 MPa, Z 2250 ± 130 MPa), melt index (7.56 ± 1.4 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption rate (0.53% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), support material ("Turn on"), spool material (PC+ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing of prints (80 to 90 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products. The 0.45 MPa heat deflection row (99 °C) is in the HDT row's test_condition (the registry has one HDT key per scope).

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (p.1, "Chamber Temperature 45 - 60 °C") is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (registry type number, template field chamber_temp_max), and this is a recommended range for printing the filament; no other filament file stores it.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu ABS GF", model "B50-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 fibre handling warning (gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI / IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS; its page 1 gives "No.: SDS20260701B50" but "Report Number : SDS20250724B50". Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS.

Store page consistency: the parsed store page gives material.diameter 1.75 mm and material.net_weight 1000 g (1 kg); both agree with the TDS. The page's two "Parameters Comparison" tables (content blocks, not parsed as spec rows) give for ABS-GF: bending modulus XY 2860 MPa, bending strength XY 68 MPa and Z 46 MPa, impact strength XY 14.5 kJ/m² and Z 5.3 kJ/m², HDT (0.45 MPa) 99 °C, saturated water absorption 0.53, composition "Acrylonitrile - butadiene - styrene, glass fiber"; every one agrees with the TDS. (The same tables give regular ABS a bending strength XY of 64 MPa in one and 62 MPa in the other; that is the ABS product's matter.)

Source disagreements kept for review: heated-bed drying time (glass-fibre wiki "90 - 100 °C, 8h" vs TDS "X1 Series Printer Heatbed: 90 - 100 °C, 12 h" and drying wiki 12 h; not stored); AMS lite (store page and glass-fibre wiki "not compatible" vs material-table wiki "Not Recommended"; the relation keeps "not compatible" with a conflict note).
not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition temperature; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/a2559301970043ae8748881b99d4c751.pdf) that was not cached; safety.certifications is left to review and is not marked not_published.

motion.max_flow is neither curated nor marked not_published: the glass-fibre wiki's speed table (Advanced Adjustments › 1. Improve Surface Quality, "ABS-GF | ＜180 mm/s | 12 mm³/s", column "Suggested Maximum Volumetric Flow Rate") is a slicing suggestion, and motion.max_flow is a printer / hotend key, as in the PA6-GF, PET-CF, PA6-CF, PPA-CF and PPS-CF files.

Adjudication against the second extraction.
